blocks.en: One of the applications of the transformation theorem is that we can now define Sobolev spaces on manifolds. Let $M$ be a compact $p$-dimensional surface in $\mathbb{R}^m$. We assume that $M$ is smooth of class $C^k$, $k\geq1$. Then every point in $M$ has a neighborhood within which $M$ can be represented in the form $\bm{x}=\bm{g}(\bm{y})$, where $\bm{y}\in\mathbb{R}^p$ and $\bm{g}$ is of class $C^k$. We can cover $M$ with a finite number of such neighborhoods; let us call them $U_i$, $1\leq i\leq N$, and let $\bm{g}_i:N_i\to U_i\cap M$ be the corresponding parametric representations of the surface. We make the following definition:
blocks.zh: 变换定理的一个应用是, 现在可以定义流形上的 Sobolev 空间. 设 $M$ 为 $\mathbb{R}^m$ 中的紧 $p$ 维曲面. 假设 $M$ 为光滑的 $C^k$ 类曲面, $k\geq1$. 那么 $M$ 中每个点都有一个邻域, 在其中 $M$ 可表示为 $\bm{x}=\bm{g}(\bm{y})$, 其中 $\bm{y}\in\mathbb{R}^p$, $\bm{g}$ 为 $C^k$ 类. 可以用有限个这样的邻域覆盖 $M$; 将其记为 $U_i$, $1\leq i\leq N$, 并设 $\bm{g}_i:N_i\to U_i\cap M$ 为曲面对应的参数表示. 作如下定义:

blocks.en: Let $M$ be as described above and let $l\leq k$ be a non-negative integer. We say that $u\in H^l(M)$ if $\phi_i(u\circ\bm{g}_i)\in H^l(\mathbb{R}^p)$ for every $i=1,\ldots,N$.
blocks.zh: 设 $M$ 如上所述, $l\leq k$ 为非负整数. 若对每个 $i=1,\ldots,N$, 有 $\phi_i(u\circ\bm{g}_i)\in H^l(\mathbb{R}^p)$, 则说 $u\in H^l(M)$.

blocks.en: Let $0\leq l\leq k$ with $k\in\mathbb{N}$ and $l$ real. Let $\bm{\Phi}$ be a $k$-diffeomorphism of $\mathbb{R}^m$. Then the pullback operator $\bm{\Phi}^*$ is a bounded linear mapping from $H^l(\mathbb{R}^m)$ onto itself.
blocks.zh: 设 $0\leq l\leq k$, 其中 $k\in\mathbb{N}$, $l$ 为实数. 设 $\bm{\Phi}$ 为 $\mathbb{R}^m$ 的 $k$ 阶微分同胚. 那么拉回算子 $\bm{\Phi}^*$ 为从 $H^l(\mathbb{R}^m)$ 到其自身的有界线性满射.

blocks.en: A proof can be based either on the theory of interpolation spaces or on \eqref{eq:fractional-sobolev-intrinsic-inner-product}. In applications, we are interested in Sobolev spaces on manifolds primarily for boundary data, and $l$ is a half-integer. For $l$ a half-integer, we shall obtain Theorem~\ref{thm:fractional-order-pullback-transformation} later as a corollary of the trace theorem.
blocks.zh: 证明可以基于插值空间理论, 也可以基于 \eqref{eq:fractional-sobolev-intrinsic-inner-product}. 在应用中, 关注流形上的 Sobolev 空间主要是为了边界数据, 而 $l$ 为半整数. 对半整数 $l$, 后面将作为迹定理的推论得到 Theorem~\ref{thm:fractional-order-pullback-transformation}.
